maddeler.e:
أتمضمض (form IIq)
# أَتَمَضْمَضُ (ʔatamaḍmaḍu) /ʔa.ta.madˤ.ma.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَضْمَضَ (tamaḍmaḍa)
# أَتَمَضْمَضَ (ʔatamaḍmaḍa) /ʔa.ta.madˤ.ma.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَضْمَضَ (tamaḍmaḍa)
# أَتَمَضْمَضْ (ʔatamaḍmaḍ) /ʔa.ta.madˤ.madˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَضْمَضَ (tamaḍmaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
